title: Access Tokens
description: Manage API keys and personal access tokens for programmatic access to the registry.
apiKeysDescription: Use API keys for programmatic access to the registry API.
accessTokensDescription: Personal access tokens for CLI and CI/CD authentication. Tokens can be scoped to specific repositories.
noApiKeysDescription: Create an API key for programmatic access to the registry.
noAccessTokensDescription: Create a personal access token for CLI or CI/CD authentication.
apiKeyCreatedDescription: Copy your API key now. You will not be able to see it again.
createApiKeyDescription: Generate a new API key for programmatic access.
tokenCreatedDescription: Copy your access token now. You will not be able to see it again.
createTokenDescription: Generate a personal access token for CLI or CI/CD authentication.
revokeKeyDescription: This will permanently invalidate this API key. Any applications using it will lose access immediately.
revokeTokenDescription: This will permanently invalidate this access token. Any sessions using it will be terminated.
